Ἀχάζ.long: Ahaz, son of Jotham and father of Hezekiah.

ἄχυρον.as:
ἄχυρον, -ον, τό,
[in LXX chiefly for תֶּבֶן;]
chaff: Mt 3:12, Lk 3:17.†

ἄχρι.g: as far as, up to, until
ἄχρι.long: as far as, up to, until, during.
ἄχρι.sd: (of time) until or (of place) up to
ἄχρι.kj: as far as, for, in(-to), till, (even, un-)to, until, while
ἄχρι.der: akin to G206 (ἄκρον) (through the idea of a terminus);
ἄχρι.as:
ἄχρι
(and Epic ἄχρις, bef. vowel (v. MM, s.v.), Ro 11:25 T, Ga 3:19 T, WH, mg., He 3:13);
1. adv., utterly (Hom.).
2. Prep. c. gen., until, unto, as far as;
(a) of time: Ac 3:2122:22, Ro 1:135:13, I Co 4:11, II Co 3:14, Ga 4:2, Phl 1:6; ἄ. καιροῦ, Lk 4:13, Ac 13:11; ἄ. ἧς ἡμέρας, Mt 24:38, Lk 1:2017:27, Ac 1:2 (τῆς ἡ. ἧς), Ac 1:22; ἄ. ταύτης τ. ἡμέρας (τ. ἡ. ταύτης), Ac 2:2923:126:22; ἄ. ἡμερῶν πέντε, Ac 20:6; ἄ. αὐγῆς, Ac 20:11; ἄ. τοῦ νῦν, Ro 8:22, Phl 1:5; ἄ. τέλους, He 6:11, Re 2:26;
(b) of space: Ac 11:513:620:4 (R, txt., WH, mg.) 28:15, II Co 10:13, 14, He 4:12, Re 14:2018:5;
(c) of measure or degree: ἄ. θανάτου, Ac 22:4, Re 2:1012:11.
3. As conj., until;
(a)ἄχρι alone: c. subj. aor., Ga 3:19 (ἄ. οὗ T, WH, mg.); id. without ἄν (Bl., § 65, 10), Re 7:315:820:3, 5; c. indic. fut., Re 17:17;
(b)ἄ. οὗ (i.e. ἄ. τούτου ᾧ): c. indic. aor., Ac 7:18; impf., 27:33; c. subj. aor. (Bl., ut supr.), Lk 21:24, Ro 11:25, I Co 11:2615:25, Ga 3:19, T, WH, mg.; id. with ἄν, Re 2:25; c. indic. pres., while, He 3:13 (cf. μέχρι).†

ἀχρεῖος.der: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G5534 (χρή) (compare G5532 (χρεία));
ἀχρεῖος.as:
ἀ-χρεῖος, -ον
(< χρεῖος, useful), [in LXX: II Ki 6:22 (שָׁפָל), Ep. Je 17*;]
useless, unprofitable: Mt 25:30, Lk 17:10 (MM, s.v.).†

ἀχειροποίητος.g: not made by hand, not handmade
ἀχειροποίητος.der: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G5499 (χειροποίητος);
ἀχειροποίητος.as:
*† ἀ-χειρο-ποίητος, -ον
(< χειροποίητος),
not made by hands: Mk 14:58, II Co 5:1; metaph., περιτομή ἀ. (i.e. spiritual), Col 2:11 (MM, s.v.).†

ἀχάριστος.der: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G5483 (χαρίζομαι);
ἀχάριστος.as:
** ἀχάριστος, -ον
(< χαρίζομαι), [in LXX: Wi 16:29, Si 29:17, 25, IV Mac 9:10*;]
(a)ungracious, unpleasing;
(b)ungrateful, thankless: Lk 6:35, II Ti 3:2.†

ἀχλύς.sd: dimness of sight, i.e. (probably) a cataract
ἀχλύς.as:
** ἀχλύς, -ύος, ἡ,
[in Aq.: Ez 12:7; Sm.: Jb 3:5*;]
a mist, esp. a dimness of the eyes: Ac 13:11 (v. Tr., Syn., § c).†

Ἀχαΐα.long: the Roman Province Achaia, governed by a proconsul, and practically conterminous with modern Greece before 1912.
Ἀχαΐα.sd: Achaia (i.e. Greece), a country of Europe
Ἀχαΐα.as:
Ἀχαία (T, Ἀχαΐα), -ας, ἡ (Bl., § 46, 11),
Achaia, the Roman province: Ac 18:12, 2719:21, Ro 15:26, I Co 16:15, II Co 1:19:211:10, I Th 1:7, 8.†

ἀχρειόομαι.long: (lit: I become sour, I turn, of milk), I am good for nothing, render useless; met: I become corrupt.
ἀχρειόομαι.as:
† ἀχρεόω (Rec. -ειόω, Polyb., LXX), -ῶ
(< ἄχρεος = ἀχρεῖος), [in LXX (-ειόω) for אלח ni., etc.;]
to make useless, unprofitable: pass., Ro 3:12(LXX).†

ἄχρις.long: as far as, up to, until, during.
ἄχρις.sd: (of time) until or (of place) up to
ἄχρις.kj: as far as, for, in(-to), till, (even, un-)to, until, while
ἄχρις.der: akin to G206 (ἄκρον) (through the idea of a terminus);
ἄχρις.as:
ἄχρι
(and Epic ἄχρις, bef. vowel (v. MM, s.v.), Ro 11:25 T, Ga 3:19 T, WH, mg., He 3:13);
1. adv., utterly (Hom.).
2. Prep. c. gen., until, unto, as far as;
(a) of time: Ac 3:2122:22, Ro 1:135:13, I Co 4:11, II Co 3:14, Ga 4:2, Phl 1:6; ἄ. καιροῦ, Lk 4:13, Ac 13:11; ἄ. ἧς ἡμέρας, Mt 24:38, Lk 1:2017:27, Ac 1:2 (τῆς ἡ. ἧς), Ac 1:22; ἄ. ταύτης τ. ἡμέρας (τ. ἡ. ταύτης), Ac 2:2923:126:22; ἄ. ἡμερῶν πέντε, Ac 20:6; ἄ. αὐγῆς, Ac 20:11; ἄ. τοῦ νῦν, Ro 8:22, Phl 1:5; ἄ. τέλους, He 6:11, Re 2:26;
(b) of space: Ac 11:513:620:4 (R, txt., WH, mg.) 28:15, II Co 10:13, 14, He 4:12, Re 14:2018:5;
(c) of measure or degree: ἄ. θανάτου, Ac 22:4, Re 2:1012:11.
3. As conj., until;
(a)ἄχρι alone: c. subj. aor., Ga 3:19 (ἄ. οὗ T, WH, mg.); id. without ἄν (Bl., § 65, 10), Re 7:315:820:3, 5; c. indic. fut., Re 17:17;
(b)ἄ. οὗ (i.e. ἄ. τούτου ᾧ): c. indic. aor., Ac 7:18; impf., 27:33; c. subj. aor. (Bl., ut supr.), Lk 21:24, Ro 11:25, I Co 11:2615:25, Ga 3:19, T, WH, mg.; id. with ἄν, Re 2:25; c. indic. pres., while, He 3:13 (cf. μέχρι).†

ἄχρηστος.der: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G5543 (χρηστός);
ἄχρηστος.as:
ἄ-χρηστος, -ον,
[in LXX: Ho 8:8 (חֵפֶץאַיִן), Wi 2:11, Si 16:1, al.;]
useless, unserviceable: opp. to εὔχρηστος, Phm 11.†
